text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer...
And here I thought I'd get it this time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps due to the consecutive losses,
Oguri Cap is visibly depressed.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Won't you tell me?
What must I do in my current state to win...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate, I won't even be able to eat
more than three bowls of my beloved rice..."
choice_data_list: Let's not rush—let's take things nice and slow.
Let's refocus and get fired up again!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
You're right.
Maybe I was feeling impatient after all those consecutive losses.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: "To breed a good variety, it's important not to rush and to learn through trial and error."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Tome-san said so, too.
I want to keep learning through trial and error just like everyone else.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Oguri Cap back in her usual form,
I felt we could look forward to the next race.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: True, back home, even when the harvest failed, not a single person ever lost heart.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"'Nevah give up, Oguri-chan.'
...That's what she said with a laugh."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I won't give up either, just like everyone else.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a fierce light dwelling in Oguri Cap's eyes,
we threw ourselves into training harder than ever before.
